title.en: On the True Qi from Ancient Times

summary: Discusses the relationship between human qi and heavenly qi, explaining how environmental factors affect health.

sections.title: Human Qi and Heavenly Qi
sections.originalText: 黄帝曰：夫自古通天者，生之本，本于阴阳。天地之间，六合之内，其气九州、九窍、五脏、十二节，皆通乎天气。
sections.translation: The Yellow Emperor said: Those who have communicated with heaven since ancient times grasp the root of life, which is based on yin and yang. Between heaven and earth, within the six directions, their qi in the nine provinces, nine orifices, five zang organs, and twelve joints all communicate with heavenly qi.
sections.interpretation: This establishes the fundamental principle that human life is intimately connected with cosmic forces. The "nine provinces" refers to the body regions, "nine orifices" are the sensory openings, "five zang organs" are the core internal organs, and "twelve joints" represent the structural framework - all resonating with heavenly patterns.
